arch-linux.name: Arch Linux
arch-linux.blurb: Minimalist rolling-release slate and Arch blue with contour ridges and a subtle pacman dot stream.

cachyos.name: CachyOS
cachyos.blurb: Speed-tuned oceanic slate with emerald-teal and cyan BORE scheduler waveforms.

ubuntu.name: Ubuntu
ubuntu.blurb: Canonical orange and aubergine plum over warm Yaru cream or midnight charcoal.

linux-mint.name: Linux Mint
linux-mint.blurb: Fresh Mint-Y botanical leaf-green over crisp porcelain or dark moss slate.

fedora.name: Fedora
fedora.blurb: Clean Adwaita blue and porcelain curves with flowing infinity-ribbon geometry.

debian.name: Debian
debian.blurb: Timeless Debian crimson over archival ivory or deep obsidian-burgundy.

nixos.name: NixOS
nixos.blurb: Declarative Nix blue-ice over cool snow or midnight slate with a 60-degree lambda lattice.

opensuse.name: openSUSE
opensuse.blurb: Geeko emerald-green and Tumbleweed deep pine-teal with rolling wireframe waves.

pop-os.name: Pop!_OS
pop-os.blurb: System76 COSMIC teal and warm amber over neutral stone or warm dark graphite.

manjaro.name: Manjaro
manjaro.blurb: Mineral jade and emerald pillars paired with slow-drifting alpine contour lines.

endeavouros.name: EndeavourOS
endeavouros.blurb: Cosmic violet, coral, and periwinkle over soft lilac mist or deep space night.

kali-linux.name: Kali Linux
kali-linux.blurb: Tactical obsidian-midnight and steel blue with quiet radar sweep and packet lattice.

gentoo.name: Gentoo
gentoo.blurb: Portage lavender-plum over quiet archival gray or deep twilight with concentric rings.

zorin-os.name: Zorin OS
zorin-os.blurb: Airy Zorin sky blue and translucent frosted glass planes over porcelain or midnight azure.

linux-from-scratch.name: Linux From Scratch
linux-from-scratch.blurb: DocBook blueprint white and deep LFS cobalt with jigsaw blueprint lines and toolchain build ticks.
